results.title: Ogun Communities Protest Alleged Land Allocation to Chinese Investors
results.snippet:
Residents of Fere and Oniporogun communities in Obafemi Owode Local Council, have embarked on a peaceful protest to express their grievances over the alleged allocation of the ancestral land to Chinese investors.

results.snippet:
LONDON, Oct 22 (Reuters) - Dangote's $1.6 billion refinery IPO ‌could grow Nigeria's active investor base fivefold, said the CEO of the country's stock exchange, which hopes it will deepen links with other African markets.

Billionaire Aliko Dangote launched what would be Africa's biggest IPO earlier this month, aiming to bring ​in millions of retail investors. The offer runs until end-October.
